description: This file defines the 'Marketing' controller class within the Opencart admin module. It handles CRUD operations, listing, and reporting related to marketing campaigns, including filtering, pagination, and rendering views for marketing management.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketing campaigns within the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, creating, editing, deleting, and reporting on marketing activities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the marketing list page with filtering options and navigation breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX or internal calls to return the marketing list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a filtered list of marketing campaigns, supports pagination, and builds the view data.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a marketing campaign.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves marketing campaign data (add or update) via AJAX call.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the marketing report in view format.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides a JSON response with marketing campaign suggestions for autocomplete fields.
